images.filename: Panathenaic amphora, Mastos Painter, AM of Nafpliko, 202347.jpg
images.caption:
Panathenaic amphora by the Mastos Painter, 530-520 BC. Archaeological Museum of Nafplion, Glymenopoulos collection.
The other side depicts the reception of a horse and this jockey, probably the winners in an equestrian event of the Great Panathenaia. The man next to the horse, who wears a short chiton is identified as the trainer (hippokomos), the beardes man on the right as the owner and the beardless youth on the left as his son.
images.alt:
Panathenaic amphora by the Mastos Painter, 530-520 BC. Archaeological Museum of Nafplion, Glymenopoulos collection.
The other side depicts the reception of a horse and this jockey, probably the winners in an equestrian event of the Great Panathenaia. The man next to the horse, who wears a short chiton is identified as the trainer (hippokomos), the beardes man on the right as the owner and the beardless youth on the left as his son.
